message.content:
{
  "title": "All Aboard the Golden Mast",
  "language": "en",
  "recommended_level": "4(ish)-hour adventure for 1st-3rd level characters",
  "hook": "A group of adventurers have all chanced upon tiny bottles with lengths of cloth stuffed into them, and they appear to be strips torn from a larger tapestry or fancy bed clothes. There’s an identical, handwritten message on each that reads as follows: 'Fortune & fame await! Meet me by the southern dock of Shulth before first light on the third day past fullest moon, and be ready to set sail! You’ll know me by my fine scarlet coat. - Lord Dunstuhl.'",
  "npcs": [
    {
      "name": "Lord Octavius Overdale Merriweather Dunstuhl",
      "role": "pirate and treasure hunter"
    }
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Shulth",
    "The Shattered Oar",
    "The Haberdasher",
    "The Vilhon Reach",
    "The Sea of Fallen Stars",
    "The Pirate Isles",
    "The treasure island"
  ],
  "threats": [
    "Lizardfolk crew",
    "Grandeur Kaine and his pirates",
    "Vicious sea creatures",
    "A cursed pirate ship",
    "A dragon turtle",
    "A kraken",
    "Grandeur Kaine",
    "A sea creature summoned by the conch"
  ],
  "rewards": [
    "12 gp",
    "Jewelry worth roughly 10 gp",
    "The treasure map",
    "A small vial of red liquid",
    "A conch shell",
    "12 bottles of vintage wine",
    "Three wine-stained outfits",
    "A velvet pouch containing the bones of a large bird",
    "A hand-sized cannon with a flint mechanism",
    "An incomplete spell scroll",
    "A note with a broken elven seal that simply reads, 'IOU'",
    "500 gold dragons"
  ]
}
